sources.title: Trace-Inverter-4B-NoBubble API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Trace-Inverter-4B-NoBubble is inspired by the no-summary/no-bubble formulation of Zhang et al., but is not an exact reproduction of their no-summary training experiment. Its target traces were originally generated by a bubble-conditioned inversion model, while the student itself receives no bubble information.
